title: v0.8.4 - Tool-Based AI Mode
description: This release transforms the AI mode from a formula-centric approach to a powerful, tool-based system capable of data analysis, formatting, calculations, and query optimization across both spreadsheet and SQL editors.

items.title: Tool-Based AI Architecture
items.description: AI can now intelligently select and execute specialized tools instead of being limited to formula generation.
details: Created SpreadsheetToolService with 22 specialized tools (10 spreadsheet + 12 query tools).
Implemented function calling architecture for dynamic tool selection.
AI automatically chooses the right tool based on user intent.

items.title: Spreadsheet AI Tools (10 Tools)
items.description: Comprehensive AI capabilities for spreadsheet operations.
details: analyze_data: Answer questions about data with actual analysis.
calculate_column: Compute values with mathematical reasoning (replaces Excel formulas).
apply_conditional_formatting: Highlight cells based on conditions.
forecast: Predict future values based on trends.
clean_data: Standardize formats, remove duplicates, fix inconsistencies.
summarize_data: Generate text summaries of key insights.
compare_data: Compare tables side-by-side.
sort_data: Sort by any column.
suggest_chart: Recommend best visualizations.
apply_template: Transform tables to match template structures.

items.title: SQL Query AI Tools (12 Tools)
items.description: Advanced AI assistance for SQL query development and optimization.
details: format_query: Prettify and indent SQL code.
explain_query: Explain queries in plain English.
optimize_query: Suggest performance improvements.
fix_query_error: Diagnose and fix syntax/runtime errors.
generate_query: Create SQL from natural language.
create_index: Suggest indexes for slow queries.
generate_test_data: Create mock data for testing.
convert_dialect: Convert between SQL dialects.
save_as_view: Create database views.
diff_queries: Compare two queries.
analyze_query_performance: Get execution metrics.

items.title: Two-Step AI Analysis
items.description: AI now provides actual answers instead of placeholders for data analysis questions.
details: First AI call: Selects appropriate tool and retrieves data.
Second AI call: Analyzes data and provides specific answers.
Example: 'Which fund has the highest value?' returns 'ICICI Prudential Multi Asset-G with value 2,520,118'.

items.title: Backend Refactoring
items.description: Streamlined AI endpoints for better maintainability.
details: Replaced /ai/generate-formula with /ai/spreadsheet-action endpoint.
Removed obsolete helper functions (buildFormulaPrompt, checkIfModifiesData).
Integrated tool execution into main AI flow.

items.title: Frontend Updates
items.description: Enhanced Grid.vue to handle diverse AI tool responses.
details: Updated generateAIFormula to executeSpreadsheetAction.
Added handlers for text answers, calculations, formatting, and sorting.
Implemented conditional formatting application logic.

items.title: Testing Infrastructure
items.description: Comprehensive test suite for validating all tools without UI.
details: Created tool-sandbox.js: Automated tests for all 22 tools.
Created interactive-tool-test.js: Interactive CLI for manual testing.
Created ai-integrated-test.js: End-to-end AI integration tests.
All tests use realistic mutual fund sample data.

items.title: Formula Generation Removed
items.description: Excel formula generation has been replaced with direct calculation tools.
details: Old /ai/generate-formula endpoint removed.
New calculate_column tool shows mathematical reasoning instead of Excel syntax.
Focus shifted from formulas to actual data manipulation.
